title: Be aware once you subscribe you CANNOT UNSUBSCRIBE!!!!
body:
Hate the app. Not use friendly at all.
Signed up for free trial but when I tried to unsubscribe it simply wouldn’t allow me to.
Got redirected so many times and error messages popped up every time so tried unsubscribing.
Got charged and lost $39.99.
Had to cancel my card to avoid further subscription charges since unsubscribing was not an option.

title: A great companion
body: I have read a fairly a large number of good self help books including the ones that give you highly valuable tips and insights to develop good habits such as Power of habit, Atomic habits. However I had not been able to apply those into my life successfully due to various excuses. I am finding this app really helpful as it guides me with daily small coaching tips, visual feedback on how I doing with my daily rituals as if I am getting the service from coach.
